decisions.name: Seated Hip Adduction
decisions.reason: Seated machine hip adduction is the library's Thigh Adductor machine.

decisions.name: Barbell Lunges Standing
decisions.reason: Same barbell forward lunge; 'standing' adds nothing.

decisions.name: Barbell Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Source describes an overhead barbell triceps extension, already in the library.

decisions.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Seated palms-up barbell wrist curl with forearms on thighs; same exercise.

decisions.name: Abdominal Stabilization
decisions.reason: Vague name with no real description (German note says lying on a roller); cannot identify, and foam roller work is excluded.

decisions.name: Bear Walk 2
decisions.reason: Bear walk is the bear crawl; '2' is a source suffix.

decisions.name: Single Leg Extension
decisions.reason: Same single-leg machine leg extension.

decisions.name: Benchpress Dumbbells
decisions.reason: Flat dumbbell bench press; wording only.

decisions.name: Bench Press Narrow Grip
decisions.reason: Narrow-grip bench press is the close-grip barbell bench press.

decisions.name: Bent High Pulls
decisions.reason: Source describes a bent-over dumbbell row with elbows flared high, i.e. the dumbbell rear delt row.

decisions.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rows
decisions.reason: Source describes a hip-hinged row with two dumbbells; same exercise.

decisions.name: Bent Over Rowing
decisions.reason: Pronated-grip barbell bent-over row; same exercise.

decisions.name: Bent Over Rowing Reverse
decisions.reason: Underhand-grip barbell bent-over row already exists.

decisions.name: Biceps Curls With Barbell
decisions.reason: Standard barbell biceps curl.

decisions.name: Biceps Curls With SZ-bar
decisions.reason: SZ-bar is the EZ-bar; same EZ-bar curl.

decisions.name: Biceps Curl With Cable
decisions.reason: Standing straight-bar cable curl; same exercise.

decisions.name: Braced Squat
decisions.reason: Unlike the bodyweight squat, a plate is held out at arm's length, which loads the front of the body and forces a braced torso.

instructions_en: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders, holding a weight plate by its edges at chest height.
Push the plate straight out in front, brace your core, then sit the hips back and bend the knees as deep as you control.
Keep the arms extended and chest tall as you drive through your feet to stand back up.

decisions.name: Burpees
decisions.reason: Full-body conditioning move; no burpee in the library.

instructions_en: From standing, squat down and place both hands on the floor just in front of your feet.
Jump or step the feet back to a plank, lower your chest to the floor and push back up.
Bring the feet back under your hips, then jump up with arms overhead and land softly.

decisions.name: Butterfly
decisions.reason: Seated butterfly (pec deck) machine; same exercise.

decisions.name: Butterfly Narrow Grip
decisions.reason: Same pec deck movement; the narrower hand or elbow position is not a commonly distinguished variant.

decisions.name: Butterfly Reverse
decisions.reason: Reverse butterfly is the reverse pec deck.

decisions.name: Cable Woodchoppers
decisions.reason: Standing cable woodchopper; plural only.

decisions.name: Calf Raises on Hackenschmitt Machine
decisions.reason: Calf raise loaded through a hack squat machine; the library has standing, seated, Smith and leg-press calf raises but not this setup.

instructions_en: Stand in the hack squat machine, back on the pad and shoulders under the pads, with the balls of your feet on the platform edge.
Keep the knees straight and lower your heels slowly until the calves are fully stretched.
Push through the balls of your feet to rise as high as possible, pause briefly, then lower under control.

decisions.name: Close-grip Lat Pull Down
decisions.reason: Close-grip lat pulldown to the chest; same exercise.

decisions.name: Cross-Bench Dumbbell Pullovers
decisions.reason: The library's dumbbell pullover is already performed lying across the bench.

decisions.name: Crunches on Machine
decisions.reason: Same ab crunch machine.

decisions.name: Crunches With Legs Up
decisions.reason: Crunch with legs held straight up, reaching for the toes, is the library's Toe Touchers.

decisions.name: Cycling
decisions.reason: General cycling; the library already has Bicycling.

decisions.name: Deadlifts
decisions.reason: Conventional barbell deadlift.

decisions.name: Dips
decisions.reason: Standard parallel-bar dip.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
decisions.reason: Closest Dumbbell Squat holds two dumbbells at the sides; the goblet squat holds one dumbbell at the chest, giving a more upright torso. Only the heel-elevated goblet variant exists.

instructions_en: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, cupping the top end with both hands.
With feet about shoulder-width, sit down between your knees, keeping the chest up and elbows inside the knees.
Drive through the whole foot to stand, keeping the dumbbell close to your body.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lunges Standing
decisions.reason: Stationary forward lunge with dumbbells (step out and back); the library has the dumbbell walking lunge, rear lunge and split squat, and lists barbell lunge and walking lunge separately.

instructions_en: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees, back knee just above the floor.
Push off the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other leg.

decisions.name: Dumbbells on Scott Machine
decisions.reason: Scott machine is the preacher bench; dumbbell preacher curl already exists.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: One dumbbell held overhead in both hands; same overhead dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Facepull
decisions.reason: Cable rope face pull.

decisions.name: Fly With Cable
decisions.reason: Cable chest fly; wording only.

decisions.name: Fly With Dumbbells, Decline Bench
decisions.reason: Decline dumbbell fly; same exercise.

decisions.name: Skullcrusher Dumbbells
decisions.reason: Dumbbell skull crusher lying on a flat bench is the lying dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Front Raises with Plates
decisions.reason: Front raise holding a weight plate; same exercise.

decisions.name: Front Raises
decisions.reason: Generic front raise; source equipment and descriptions are mixed, and dumbbell, cable and plate versions already exist.

decisions.name: Front pull wide
decisions.reason: German 'Frontziehen breit' is the wide-grip front lat pulldown; standard Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Front Pull narrow
decisions.reason: German 'Frontziehen eng' is the close-grip front lat pulldown.

decisions.name: Full Sit Outs
decisions.reason: Plank kick-through drill from wrestling or animal-flow training, not a programmable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Glute Bridge
decisions.reason: Floor bodyweight glute bridge is the library's Butt Lift (Bridge).

decisions.name: Good Mornings
decisions.reason: Barbell good morning; plural only.

decisions.name: Hammercurls on Cable
decisions.reason: Neutral-grip cable hammer curl; same exercise.

decisions.name: Hercules Pillars
decisions.reason: Strongman-style isometric hold between two cable stacks; novelty, not a standard gym exercise.

decisions.name: High Knee Jumps
decisions.reason: Tuck jump; plyometric jumps are not imported.

decisions.name: High Pull
decisions.reason: Pull derivative started from below the knee that finishes with an elbows-high arm pull; the library's clean and snatch pulls stop at the shrug.

instructions_en: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip outside the thighs, then hinge to lower it just below the knees with a flat back.
Extend hips and knees explosively, shrug, and pull the bar close to the body with elbows leading high and wide.
Let the bar reach about chest height, then lower it under control back to the hang position.

decisions.name: Hindu Squats
decisions.reason: Unlike the bodyweight squat, the heels rise at the bottom and the arms swing in a continuous rhythm.

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms reaching forward at shoulder height.
Swing the arms back as you squat down, letting the heels rise so you finish on the balls of your feet.
Drive up to standing, lowering the heels and swinging the arms forward in one smooth rhythm.

decisions.name: Hyperextensions
decisions.reason: Same back extension on the hyperextension bench.

decisions.name: Incline Plank With Alternate Floor Touch
decisions.reason: Plank with the feet on a gym ball; stability balls are excluded.

decisions.name: Jogging
decisions.reason: Jogging is outdoor running at an easier pace; same exercise as Run (included in this batch).

decisions.name: Jumping Jacks
decisions.reason: Basic conditioning move; the library only has the plyometric Star Jump.

instructions_en: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump the feet out wider than the shoulders while sweeping the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady, light rhythm on the balls of your feet.

decisions.name: Cable Cross-over
decisions.reason: Shoulder-height cable crossover is the standing cable chest fly.

decisions.name: Squats on Multipress
decisions.reason: Multipress is the Smith machine; Smith machine squat.

decisions.name: Lateral Rows on Cable, One Armed
decisions.reason: German title and description are a one-arm cable lateral raise.

decisions.name: Lateral-to-Front Raises
decisions.reason: Same lateral-raise-to-front-raise combination.

decisions.name: Lat Pull Down (Leaning Back)
decisions.reason: Leaning back slightly is a technique cue for the standard lat pulldown, not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Lat Pull Down (Straight Back)
decisions.reason: Upright torso is a technique cue for the standard lat pulldown, not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Generic machine leg curl; lying leg curl is the default.

decisions.name: Leg Curls (laying)
decisions.reason: Lying machine leg curl.

decisions.name: Leg Curls (sitting)
decisions.reason: Seated machine leg curl.

decisions.name: Leg Curls (standing)
decisions.reason: Standing single-leg machine curl.

decisions.name: Leg Presses (narrow)
decisions.reason: Narrow-stance leg press already exists.

decisions.name: Leg Presses (wide)
decisions.reason: Stance variant: the library has the standard and narrow-stance leg press; a wide stance with toes out shifts more work to the glutes and adductors.

instructions_en: Sit in the leg press with feet wider than shoulder-width on the platform, toes turned slightly out.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until the knees reach about 90 degrees, tracking over the toes.
Press through your heels to extend the legs without locking the knees.

decisions.name: Leg Press on Hackenschmidt Machine
decisions.reason: Squatting on the Hackenschmidt machine is the machine hack squat.

decisions.name: Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Lying straight-leg raise; floor versus bench is not a material difference.

decisions.name: Leg Raises, Lying
decisions.reason: Lying leg raise on a bench holding on overhead; same exercise.

decisions.name: Leg Raises, Standing
decisions.reason: Forearms on the pads of the leg raise station with straight legs is the captain's chair straight leg raise.

decisions.name: Diamond push ups
decisions.reason: Hand variant: hands together forming a diamond under the chest, a commonly named triceps-focused push-up distinct from the standard and close-grip versions.

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position with hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep the body in a straight line and lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Long-Pulley (low Row)
decisions.reason: Source describes a seated cable row with a wide-grip bar pulled to the navel, i.e. the seated wide-grip cable row.

decisions.name: Long-Pulley, Narrow
decisions.reason: Narrow-grip seated cable row is the standard seated cable row.

decisions.name: Low Box Squat - Wide Stance
decisions.reason: Box height and wide stance are setup choices of the barbell box squat.

decisions.name: Negative Crunches
decisions.reason: German 'Negativbank' means decline bench; this is the decline crunch.

decisions.name: Overhand Cable Curl
decisions.reason: Description is a curl with hands at shoulder height toward the head, i.e. the overhead (high) cable curl.

decisions.name: Pause Bench
decisions.reason: Named tempo variant with a dead stop on the chest; no paused bench press in the library.

instructions_en: Set up on a flat bench as for a normal bench press, feet planted and shoulder blades pulled back.
Lower the bar to your chest and hold it there motionless for about two seconds while staying tight.
Press the bar back up to straight arms without bouncing or losing your setup.

decisions.name: Pendelay Rows
decisions.reason: Pendlay row (misspelled).

decisions.name: Pike Push Ups
decisions.reason: Unlike the standard push-up, the hips are raised into an inverted V so the press becomes a vertical, shoulder-dominant movement.

instructions_en: From a push-up position, walk your feet in and lift your hips so your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to straight arms, keeping the hips high throughout.

decisions.name: Pistol Squat
decisions.reason: Single-leg squat with the free leg held straight in front; the closest Bodyweight Squat is two-legged and the library's pistol is the Smith machine version.

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with the other leg lifted straight in front and both arms reaching forward for balance.
Sit back and down on the standing leg as low as you control, keeping the heel flat and the free leg off the floor.
Drive through the standing foot to return to the top, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Prone Scapular Retraction - Arms at Side
decisions.reason: Low-load physio activation drill with an unclear arm position; not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Pull Ups on Machine
decisions.reason: Machine-assisted pull-up is covered by the library's Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up.

decisions.name: Push Press
decisions.reason: Source describes the push press with dumbbells, i.e. the dumbbell push press.

decisions.name: Rack Deadlift
decisions.reason: Deadlift from a rack with the bar just below the knee is the rack pull.

decisions.name: Renegade Row
decisions.reason: Single-arm rows from a plank on two dumbbells; no renegade row in the library.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells on the floor, feet wider than hips for balance.
Brace your core and row one dumbbell to your hip without twisting the hips, then set it down under control.
Repeat with the other arm, keeping the body in a straight line throughout.

decisions.name: Reverse Bar Curl
decisions.reason: Overhand-grip bar curl is the reverse barbell curl.

decisions.name: Reverse Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: The library's reverse triceps bench press is the underhand-grip barbell bench press.

decisions.name: Row
decisions.reason: Generic 'Row' with mixed equipment and an encyclopedia-style description; too vague to identify.

decisions.name: Rowing, Lying on Bench
decisions.reason: Rowing while lying face-down on a bench is a chest-supported row; no equipment given, the dumbbell version is the standard.

decisions.name: Rowing seated, narrow grip
decisions.reason: Seated narrow-grip cable row is the standard seated cable row.

decisions.name: Rowing, T-bar
decisions.reason: Bent-over T-bar row; same exercise.

decisions.name: Run
decisions.reason: Road or track running outdoors; the library only has treadmill running and trail running/walking.

instructions_en: Start with a few minutes of easy walking or jogging to warm up.
Run at your chosen pace, landing softly under your hips with a relaxed upper body and steady breathing.
Finish with a few minutes of easy jogging or walking before you stop.

decisions.name: Run - Interval Training
decisions.reason: Intervals are a session structure, not a different exercise; log as Outdoor Running (included in this batch).

decisions.name: Run - Treadmill
decisions.reason: Treadmill running already exists.

decisions.name: Incline Bench Press - Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Incline dumbbell bench press.

decisions.name: Incline Bench Press - MP
decisions.reason: MP means Multipress, the Smith machine; Smith machine incline bench press.

decisions.name: Scissors
decisions.reason: Lying scissor kicks; same exercise.

decisions.name: Side Bends on Machine
decisions.reason: German description is a side bend on the Roman chair, i.e. the 45-degree side bend.

decisions.name: Shotgun Row
decisions.reason: Same single-arm cable shotgun row.

decisions.name: Shoulder Press, on Multi Press
decisions.reason: Seated shoulder press on the Multipress (Smith machine).

decisions.name: Shoulder Shrug
decisions.reason: Generic shrug with no equipment given; its description matches the existing barbell shrug.

decisions.name: Shrugs on Multipress
decisions.reason: Multipress = Smith machine; the library only has the behind-the-back Smith shrug.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at mid-thigh height, grip it overhand at shoulder width and unrack it standing tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears with arms straight, pausing briefly at the top.
Lower the shoulders slowly to a full stretch without rolling them.

decisions.name: Side Crunch
decisions.reason: Source describes a standing side bend holding a weight in one hand, not a lying crunch.

decisions.name: Side Dumbbell Trunk Flexion
decisions.reason: Same dumbbell side bend under another name.

decisions.name: Side to Side Push Ups
decisions.reason: Differs from Push Up to Side Plank: the chest shifts over one hand each rep, with no rotation into a side plank.

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulders and body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your chest toward that hand, then press back up to center.
Alternate sides each rep, keeping hips level and core braced.

decisions.name: Sitting Calf Raises
decisions.reason: Seated calf raise on the calf-raise machine, already in library.

decisions.name: Skipping - Standard
decisions.reason: Skipping with a rope is the existing Rope Jumping.

decisions.name: Snach
decisions.reason: Typo of Snatch; same barbell snatch.

decisions.name: Splinter Sit-ups
decisions.reason: 'Splinter' is a typo of sprinter; unlike a plain Sit-Up it adds a twist, knee drive and running arm swing.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with legs straight and elbows bent at 90 degrees by your sides.
Sit up while twisting, driving one knee toward the opposite elbow and swinging the other arm back like a sprinter.
Lower with control to the floor and repeat to the other side.

decisions.name: Squats
decisions.reason: Barbell back squat, already in library.

decisions.name: Squat Thrust
decisions.reason: Conditioning move with a kick back to plank; not the same as Bodyweight Squat, and no jump or push-up like a burpee.

instructions_en: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a straight-arm plank, then bring them back in under your hips.
Stand up fully and repeat at a steady, quick pace.

decisions.name: Standing Bicep Curl
decisions.reason: Standard standing dumbbell biceps curl.

decisions.name: Standing Calf Raises
decisions.reason: Source uses the standing calf-raise machine; same as Standing Calf Raise.

decisions.name: Stationary Bike
decisions.reason: Same stationary bike.

decisions.name: Straight-arm Pull Down (bar Attachment)
decisions.reason: Same straight-arm cable pulldown with a bar.

decisions.name: Straight-arm Pull Down (rope Attachment)
decisions.reason: Same straight-arm pulldown with the rope.

decisions.name: Sumo Deadlift
decisions.reason: Barbell sumo deadlift, already in library.

decisions.name: Sumo Squats
decisions.reason: Wide sumo stance with no load; existing sumo and wide-stance squats use a barbell or dumbbell.

instructions_en: Stand with feet well wider than shoulders, toes turned out about 45 degrees, hands clasped at your chest.
Sit straight down, pushing knees out over your toes, until thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hold a barbell in the front rack on your shoulders, elbows high, feet shoulder-width apart.
Front squat to depth, then drive up hard and use that momentum to press the bar overhead to lockout.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders and go straight into the next squat.

decisions.name: Triceps Extensions on Cable
decisions.reason: Source describes a cable rope pushdown with the hands turned out at the bottom.

decisions.name: Triceps Extensions on Cable With Bar
decisions.reason: Same cable triceps pushdown with a bar.

decisions.name: Triceps on Machine
decisions.reason: Same seated triceps machine.

decisions.name: Trunk Rotation With Cable
decisions.reason: Seated rotation; existing cable twists are lying on a ball or diagonal standing wood chops.

instructions_en: Set a cable handle at chest height and sit sideways to the stack, holding the handle with both hands, arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the machine, keeping the arms straight and hips still.
Return slowly to the start, resisting the pull, then switch sides.
Lie on your back holding a dumbbell straight above one shoulder, same-side knee bent and foot flat.
Keeping the arm locked, roll to your elbow, then hand, lift your hips, sweep the leg under to kneel, and stand up.
Reverse each step slowly back to the floor, then switch hands.

decisions.name: Underhand Lat Pull Down
decisions.reason: Underhand-grip lat pulldown, already in library.

decisions.name: Overhead Press
decisions.reason: Standing barbell overhead press, already in library.

decisions.name: Upper External Oblique
decisions.reason: Named after a muscle; the source gives no identifiable movement.

decisions.name: Upright Row, on Multi Press
decisions.reason: Multipress = Smith machine; same Smith upright row.

decisions.name: Upright Row, SZ-bar
decisions.reason: EZ-bar instead of a straight bar; same upright row with no material difference.

decisions.name: Upright Row w/ Dumbbells
decisions.reason: Same dumbbell upright row.

decisions.name: Calf raises, one legged
decisions.reason: Standing single-leg bodyweight version; the library only has machine, loaded or seated one-leg raises.

instructions_en: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, heel hanging off, lightly holding a support for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of the foot and pause briefly.
Lower slowly until the heel drops below the step, then switch legs after the set.

decisions.name: Wall Pushup
decisions.reason: Hands on a wall with the body nearly upright; a beginner regression, unlike the floor push-up.

instructions_en: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place your hands on it at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulders.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, keeping your body straight from head to heels.
Push back to straight arms without letting the hips sag.

decisions.name: Wall Slides
decisions.reason: Shoulder mobility and warm-up drill, not a training exercise.

decisions.name: Wall Squat
decisions.reason: Isometric hold with the back on a wall; Bodyweight Squat is a dynamic squat.

instructions_en: Stand with your back flat against a wall and walk your feet out about two feet in front of you.
Slide down until hips and knees are bent to about 90 degrees, knees over ankles.
Hold with your back on the wall and weight in your heels, then slide up to finish.

decisions.name: Wide-grip Pulldown
decisions.reason: Wide-grip variant in front of the head; the library has the standard Lat Pulldown and a behind-the-neck wide pulldown.

instructions_en: Sit at a lat pulldown with thighs under the pads and grip the bar well outside shoulder width, palms forward.
Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving the elbows down and back, chest up.
Let the bar rise under control until your arms are fully extended.

decisions.name: Tricep Pushdown on Cable
decisions.reason: Source describes the cable rope push-down.

decisions.name: Front Plate Raise
decisions.reason: Same front raise holding a weight plate.

decisions.name: Incline Bench Reverse Fly
decisions.reason: Existing Reverse Flyes is already the chest-down incline-bench dumbbell version.

decisions.name: Rear Delt Raise
decisions.reason: Source describes a seated, bent-over dumbbell rear delt raise.

decisions.name: Zone 2 Running
decisions.reason: Zone 2 is an intensity, not an exercise; same as the outdoor run candidate.

instructions_en: Kneel on a pad with knees hip-width apart, ankles anchored, and your body straight from knees to head.
Keeping hips extended, lean back slowly by bending only at the knees, as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back to upright.

decisions.name: Nordic Curl
decisions.reason: Kneeling with ankles held and lowering under hamstring control is the Nordic curl, already in library.

decisions.name: Incline Skull Crush
decisions.reason: Source uses dumbbells; the library's incline triceps extensions use a barbell or cable.

instructions_en: Lie on a bench set to about 45 degrees, holding dumbbells above your shoulders with palms facing each other.
Keeping upper arms still, bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend the elbows to press the weights back up, squeezing the triceps.

decisions.name: Straight Bar Cable Curls
decisions.reason: Same standing cable curl with a straight bar.

decisions.name: Reverse Preacher Curl (Close Grip)
decisions.reason: Same EZ-bar reverse-grip preacher curl; the closer grip is not a material change here.

decisions.name: Reverse EZ Bar Cable Curls
decisions.reason: Same reverse-grip cable curl; EZ attachment instead of a straight bar.

decisions.name: BUS DRIVERS
decisions.reason: Bus drivers and car drivers are the same plate steering-wheel rotation.

decisions.name: Smith Press
decisions.reason: Source describes a seated Smith machine shoulder press.

decisions.name: Straight Bar Cable Front Raise
decisions.reason: Two-handed bar version; the library's Front Cable Raise is single-arm with a handle.

instructions_en: Attach a bar to a low pulley and stand facing away, cable between your legs, holding the bar overhand at your thighs.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the bar in front of you to shoulder height without leaning back.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.

decisions.name: Seated Dumbbell Side Lateral
decisions.reason: Same seated dumbbell lateral raise.

decisions.name: T-Bar row
decisions.reason: Same bent-over T-bar row with a close handle.

decisions.name: SEATED CABLE MID TRAP SHRUG
decisions.reason: Mid-trap retraction with straight arms; differs from a full cable row or an upward shrug.

instructions_en: Sit at a seated cable row with a close-grip handle, knees soft, torso upright and arms fully extended.
Without bending the elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold briefly.
Let the shoulder blades spread forward slowly, keeping your chest tall.

decisions.name: LYING DUMBBELL ROW SS SEATED SHRUG
decisions.reason: A superset of two exercises (dumbbell row plus shrug), not a single exercise.

decisions.name: SMITH MACHINE SLIGHT INCLINE PRESS
decisions.reason: A slight incline is still the Smith machine incline press.

decisions.name: Machine chest fly
decisions.reason: Seated machine chest fly is the existing Butterfly (pec deck).

decisions.name: Suspended crossess
decisions.reason: Needs TRX/suspension straps.

decisions.name: Quadriped Arm and Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Opposite arm and leg raise on all fours is the Bird Dog.

decisions.name: Swimming 50m sprints
decisions.reason: Kept as general swimming; the source's 50 m sprints are an interval session of it.

instructions_en: Choose a stroke and swim lengths at a pace you can hold, keeping your body long near the surface.
Breathe rhythmically, exhaling underwater and inhaling during the stroke.
For intervals, alternate fast lengths with easy lengths or short rests at the wall.

decisions.name: Elliptical
decisions.reason: Same elliptical trainer.

decisions.name: Box squat
decisions.reason: Source describes the standard box squat, with the barbell as the loading option.

decisions.name: Knee Raises
decisions.reason: Knee raises on a pull-up bar are the Hanging Knee Raise.

decisions.name: Leg raises pull up bar
decisions.reason: Straight-leg raises on a pull-up bar are the Hanging Leg Raise.

decisions.name: commando pull-ups
decisions.reason: Close staggered grip with the head passing alternate sides of the bar; not a standard or weighted pull-up.

instructions_en: Stand side-on under the bar and grip it with hands close together, one in front of the other.
Pull up so your head passes to one side of the bar, then lower to a dead hang.
Alternate the side your head passes on each rep without twisting your torso.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at your sides.
Run in place, driving each knee up to about hip height and pumping your arms.
Stay light on the balls of your feet and keep your torso upright.

decisions.name: Jump rope: basic jumps
decisions.reason: Basic jump rope is the existing Rope Jumping.

decisions.name: 4-count burpees
decisions.reason: The four-count burpee is the squat thrust (squat, kick back to plank, return, stand).

decisions.name: No push-up burpees
decisions.reason: A burpee with the push-up left out is a scaling of the burpee, not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Left neck stretch
decisions.reason: Side neck stretch; left-side version only.

decisions.name: Right neck stretch
decisions.reason: Side neck stretch; right-side version only.

decisions.name: Back neck stretch
decisions.reason: Chin to chest with hands behind the head is the existing stretch.

decisions.name: Front neck stretch
decisions.reason: Neck extension stretch; the library only has side-bend and chin-to-chest neck stretches.

instructions_en: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of the neck.
Hold while breathing slowly, then bring your head back to neutral with control.

decisions.name: Left levator scapulae stretch
decisions.reason: Rotated, flexed neck stretch; differs from the plain side neck stretch.

instructions_en: Sit tall and turn your head about 45 degrees toward one armpit, holding the seat with the opposite hand.
Place the free hand on the back of your head and gently draw your chin down toward that armpit.
Hold the stretch along the back and side of the neck, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Right levator scapulae stretch
decisions.reason: Right-side version of the levator scapulae stretch.

decisions.name: Plate twist
decisions.reason: Same seated plate twist.

decisions.name: Hindu Pushups
decisions.reason: Flowing dive from a pike to an arched top position; not a standard push-up.

instructions_en: Start in a pike with hips high, hands and feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Bend the elbows and swoop your chest forward close to the floor, then straighten the arms and arch up with hips low.
Push your hips back up to return to the pike.

decisions.name: Close-grip Press-ups
decisions.reason: Close-hand push-up with elbows tucked is the existing close triceps push-up.

decisions.name: Vpushup
decisions.reason: V push-up is the pike push-up.

instructions_en: Hold a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder, keeping your hips square and still.
Place the hand back down and alternate sides with control.

decisions.name: Bag training
decisions.reason: Boxing heavy-bag work is sport training and too vague to log as one exercise.

decisions.name: Rowing Machine
decisions.reason: Same rowing machine.

decisions.name: Seated rear delt rise
decisions.reason: Typo of raise; same seated bent-over rear delt raise.

decisions.name: Horizontal traction isometry
decisions.reason: Source describes a timed isometric pull-up hold; same as the Pull-up Isometric Hold candidate.

decisions.name: Alternate back lunges
decisions.reason: Unloaded reverse lunge; the library's rear lunges use dumbbells, a barbell, or a crossover step.

instructions_en: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend about 90 degrees, front shin near vertical.
Push through the front heel to return to standing and alternate legs.

decisions.name: walking bridge
decisions.reason: Walking the hands out from a forward bend is the inchworm.

decisions.name: Walking
decisions.reason: Steady walking outdoors or indoors, not the lunge; the library only has treadmill and trail walking.

instructions_en: Walk upright with relaxed shoulders, swinging your arms naturally.
Land on the heel and roll through to push off the toes, keeping a brisk, steady pace.
Raise the pace or choose hills to make it harder.

decisions.name: Seated Knee Tuck
decisions.reason: Same seated knee tuck with a backward lean.

decisions.name: Cable Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Cable version; library concentration curls use dumbbells or a barbell.

instructions_en: Set a handle on a low pulley and sit on a bench beside it, resting the back of your upper arm on your inner thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm still, and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Push-Ups | Parallettes
decisions.reason: Hands raised on parallettes let the chest drop below hand level; deeper range than a floor push-up.

instructions_en: Set parallettes or push-up handles shoulder-width apart, grip them palms in, and form a straight plank.
Lower your chest between the handles below hand level, elbows close to your sides.
Press back up to straight arms, keeping your body rigid.

decisions.name: 3D lunge warmup
decisions.reason: Warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Arabesque
decisions.reason: The source's 'arabesque' is a bodyweight single-leg Romanian deadlift.

decisions.name: Alternating Biceps Curls With Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Same alternating dumbbell curl with supination.

decisions.name: PALLOF PRESS
decisions.reason: Same cable Pallof press.

decisions.name: Side Slides + Squats
decisions.reason: Agility drill combining lateral shuffles with squats.

decisions.name: Wall Drills
decisions.reason: Vague lateral wall drills for rehab or sport, not one identifiable exercise.

decisions.name: Dragon squat
decisions.reason: Source describes crossing one foot behind and bending both knees: a curtsy squat.

decisions.name: Calf raises, left leg
decisions.reason: Left-leg version of the single-leg calf raise.

decisions.name: Cycling cardio session
decisions.reason: A stationary-bike cardio session is the existing stationary bike.

decisions.name: Front lever tuck
decisions.reason: Tuck progression of the front lever, a different exercise from the full lever.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and straight arms.
Pull the bar toward your hips with straight arms, tuck your knees to your chest and lift your back level with the floor.
Hold with shoulders pulled down and hips level, then lower under control.
Lie face down with arms extended overhead, thumbs up, and forehead just off the floor.
Lift your arms slightly and sweep them in a wide arc down to your hips, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Sweep them back overhead without letting them touch the floor.

decisions.name: knee push-ups
decisions.reason: Knees stay on the floor to reduce load; a regression of the standard push-up.

instructions_en: Kneel on a mat with hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending the elbows, keeping your hips in line.
Press back up to straight arms.

decisions.name: Australian pull-ups
decisions.reason: Australian pull-up is another name for the bodyweight inverted row.

decisions.name: Claps over the head
decisions.reason: Overhead clapping is a warm-up drill, not a training exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell drag curls
decisions.reason: Dumbbell version; the library's Drag Curl uses a barbell.

instructions_en: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up along your torso while drawing your elbows back behind your body.
Squeeze at chest height, then lower slowly along the same path.

decisions.name: Dumbbell wide bicep curls
decisions.reason: Curl with the hands held outside shoulder width; grip width differs from the standard dumbbell curl.

instructions_en: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward, arms angled out so your hands sit wider than your shoulders.
Keep your elbows near your sides and curl the dumbbells up toward your outer shoulders.
Lower under control to full extension without swinging.

decisions.name: Dumbbell bicep curl to press
decisions.reason: Curl and overhead press combined in one rep; not in the library.

instructions_en: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders, then press them overhead, turning your palms forward as you lock out.
Lower them to your shoulders, then uncurl to the start under control.

decisions.name: Dumbbell rear delt row
decisions.reason: Dumbbell version; the library has only the barbell rear delt row.

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Row the dumbbells up with your elbows flared wide until your upper arms are level with your shoulders.
Pause, then lower slowly without letting your torso rise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell close grip bench press
decisions.reason: Two dumbbells squeezed together throughout (squeeze press); the library's Close-Grip Dumbbell Press uses one dumbbell held across the palms.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other and the dumbbells touching.
Squeeze the dumbbells hard together and lower them to your mid-chest.
Press back up to lockout while keeping the dumbbells pressed together.

decisions.name: Dumbbell upright-row
decisions.reason: Same two-dumbbell upright row.

decisions.name: Triceps stretch left
decisions.reason: Left-side version of the triceps stretch.

decisions.name: Triceps stretch right
decisions.reason: Right-side version of the triceps stretch.

decisions.name: Standing biceps stretch left
decisions.reason: Left-side version of the standing biceps stretch.

decisions.name: Standing biceps stretch right
decisions.reason: Right-side version of the standing biceps stretch.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single-leg Hip Thrust
decisions.reason: Single-leg stance with a dumbbell; the library has only the two-leg barbell hip thrust and a floor single-leg glute bridge. Source equipment (barbell) corrected to dumbbell.

instructions_en: Rest your upper back on a bench, hold a dumbbell on the hip of your working leg, and lift the other foot.
Drive through the heel of the planted foot to raise your hips until your torso and thigh line up.
Squeeze the glute at the top, then lower your hips under control.

decisions.name: Frog stand
decisions.reason: Calisthenics arm-balance hold; not in the library.

instructions_en: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
Rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms and lean forward until your feet lift off the floor.
Hold the balance with your gaze slightly forward and core braced, then lower your feet with control.

decisions.name: Standing Calf Stretch
decisions.reason: Same standing gastrocnemius calf stretch.

decisions.name: Standing Soleus Stretch
decisions.reason: Same standing bent-knee soleus stretch.

decisions.name: Double Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Two-leg bodyweight standing calf raise; library versions use a machine, barbell or dumbbells.

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or rail lightly for balance.
Rise onto the balls of both feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels slowly to the floor.

decisions.name: Yoga exercise: Cow-cat
decisions.reason: Cat-cow is a dynamic yoga mobility flow; the static Cat Stretch is already in the library.

decisions.name: Front Lever
decisions.reason: Full front lever hold; a harder progression than the tuck front lever. Source equipment (machine) corrected to bodyweight.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and straight arms.
Press the bar toward your hips with straight arms and raise your body until it is horizontal, face up.
Hold with legs together, hips extended and core braced, then lower under control.

decisions.name: Ice Scream maker
decisions.reason: Calisthenics move linking the top of a pull-up to a front lever (name typo fixed); not in the library.

instructions_en: Pull yourself up on a bar until your chin is above it.
Keeping your body rigid, push the bar away and lift your legs until you reach a horizontal front lever with straight arms.
Reverse the motion back to the top of the pull-up without letting your hips sag.

decisions.name: Front lever pull-up
decisions.reason: Rows to the bar from a front lever position; not a vertical pull-up like Pull Ups on Machine.

instructions_en: Hang from a bar and hold a front lever, legs straight or tucked to make it easier.
Keeping your body horizontal, pull your chest toward the bar by bending your elbows.
Lower back to straight arms while holding the lever position.

decisions.name: Low Pulley Cable Fly
decisions.reason: A standing fly from the low pulleys is the Low-to-High Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Low Pulley Cable fFly
decisions.reason: Typo copy of Low Pulley Cable Fly; same as Low-to-High Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Pullover
decisions.reason: Generic dumbbell pullover; covered by Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover.

decisions.name: Sitting Calf Stretch (Dorsiflexion)
decisions.reason: Same seated calf stretch, pulling the toes toward you.

decisions.name: Biceps Close Grip Pull Down
decisions.reason: Close underhand-grip lat pulldown; same as Underhand Cable Pulldowns.

decisions.name: Incline Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
decisions.reason: The chest-supported dumbbell row is done on an incline bench; same exercise.

decisions.name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
decisions.reason: Known calisthenics push-up variant with a forward shoulder lean; not in the library.

instructions_en: Set up in a push-up position with fingers turned out, then lean forward until your shoulders are past your wrists.
Keeping that lean and a rigid body, bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up without letting your shoulders drift back behind your hands.

decisions.name: Talons fesses
decisions.reason: French name for butt kicks, a running warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Dynamic Planche
decisions.reason: Jumping the feet in to the hands and back out from a plank is the library's Groiners movement.

decisions.name: Reach ups
decisions.reason: Crunch with the arms reaching overhead; same as Crunch - Hands Overhead.

decisions.name: Planche de cote dynamique
decisions.reason: French name for the dynamic side plank; hip dips differ from the static Side Plank.

instructions_en: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, elbow under your shoulder, body straight from head to feet.
Lower your hips toward the floor without touching it.
Lift them back above the start line using your obliques, then repeat before switching sides.

decisions.name: Reverse Grip Barbell Curls
decisions.reason: Same overhand-grip barbell curl.

decisions.name: Barbell Bench Press - NB
decisions.reason: Same barbell bench press; source suffix only.

decisions.name: Low-Cable Cross-Over - NB
decisions.reason: Same low cable crossover; source suffix only.

decisions.name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher - NB
decisions.reason: Same EZ-bar skull crusher; source suffix only.

decisions.name: High-Cable Cross Tricep Extention - NB
decisions.reason: Extension with crossed high cables, each handle in the opposite hand; not in the library.

instructions_en: Stand between two high pulleys, holding each handle in the opposite hand so the cables cross in front of your face.
Keep your upper arms still and extend your elbows, pushing the handles out and down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your hands cross again.

decisions.name: Helms Row
decisions.reason: Named row done standing with the chest on the end of a flat bench; not in the library.

instructions_en: Stand behind the end of a flat bench and lean forward to rest your chest on it, torso near parallel to the floor.
Holding a dumbbell in each hand, row your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly without lifting your chest off the bench.

decisions.name: Front Plank
decisions.reason: Front plank is the standard plank.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Squat HD
decisions.reason: Same bodyweight squat; HD suffix only.

decisions.name: Jumping Jack HD
decisions.reason: Same jumping jack as the earlier Jumping Jacks candidate; HD suffix only.

decisions.name: High Knee Skips HD
decisions.reason: High-knee skipping is a running warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Crunches HD
decisions.reason: Same crunch; HD suffix only.

decisions.name: Bench Dips On Floor HD
decisions.reason: Dip with the hands on the floor; a different setup from the bench dip.

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat, and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing toward you.
Lift your hips slightly and bend your elbows straight back to lower your upper body toward the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.

decisions.name: Bodyweight lunge HD
decisions.reason: Stationary forward lunge; the library has only walking and reverse bodyweight lunges.

instructions_en: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing, then alternate legs.

decisions.name: Lateral Push Off
decisions.reason: Hopping laterally from leg to leg is a plyometric agility drill.

decisions.name: Triceps Overhead (Dumbbell)
decisions.reason: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension; same exercise.

decisions.name: Schoulder Raise (Dumbbell)
decisions.reason: Too vague: a dumbbell 'shoulder raise' could be a lateral raise, front raise or shrug, and the source gives only generic cues.

decisions.name: Triceps Dips (Assisted)
decisions.reason: Counterweighted assisted dip machine; differs from the seated Dip Machine press.

instructions_en: Set the assist weight, kneel or stand on the platform, and grip the dip handles with your arms straight.
Keeping your torso upright and elbows close, lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

decisions.name: box jumps
decisions.reason: Box jump is a plyometric jump.

decisions.name: Rotary Torso Machine
decisions.reason: Selectorized torso rotation machine; not in the library.

instructions_en: Sit in the rotary torso machine, set the start angle, and brace your chest against the pad with hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the start side using your obliques, keeping your hips still.
Return slowly, then train the other side.

decisions.name: Recumbent Bike
decisions.reason: Same recumbent bike (a machine; source equipment mapping wrong).

decisions.name: TORSO TWIST
decisions.reason: Dynamic standing torso twist is a warm-up mobility drill.

decisions.name: Upper Back
decisions.reason: Too vague to identify; the name and source text describe no specific movement.

decisions.name: Pullover Machine
decisions.reason: Machine pullover; the library has only dumbbell and barbell pullovers.

instructions_en: Sit in the pullover machine with your shoulders lined up with the pivot and your elbows on the pads.
Drive your elbows down and forward in an arc until the bar reaches your torso.
Let your arms return slowly overhead to a full lat stretch.

decisions.name: Hamstring Kicks
decisions.reason: Straight-leg kicks are a dynamic warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Single Leg RDL
decisions.reason: Unloaded version; the library's single-leg Romanian deadlift uses a dumbbell.

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms by your sides.
Hinge at the hips, reaching toward the floor as the free leg extends straight behind you, hips level.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

decisions.name: Toe Touch
decisions.reason: Same standing toe touch.

decisions.name: Elephant Walks
decisions.reason: Elephant walks are a dynamic hamstring warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Single Leg Hamstring Stretch
decisions.reason: Same seated one-leg hamstring stretch.

decisions.name: Sit & Reach
decisions.reason: Seated two-leg forward fold; same as Upper Back-Leg Grab.

decisions.name: Crossbody Leg Swings
decisions.reason: Leg swings are a dynamic warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Standing Pancake
decisions.reason: Standing wide-straddle forward fold; the library's straddle stretch is seated.

instructions_en: Stand with your feet as wide as is comfortable, toes forward and knees straight.
Hinge at the hips with a long back, pushing your hips back and reaching your hands toward the floor.
Hold where you feel a stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs, breathing slowly.

decisions.name: Standing Pancake Good Morning
decisions.reason: Dynamic wide-stance hinge done for reps, not the static Standing Pancake hold.

instructions_en: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes slightly out, and hands behind your head.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lowering your chest toward the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

decisions.name: Hamstring Chokes
decisions.reason: Dynamic hamstring mobility drill (bend and straighten the leg), similar to the library's 90/90 Hamstring.

decisions.name: Crossbody Hamstring Stretch
decisions.reason: Standing fold with the legs crossed; differs from the lying strap Hamstring Stretch and the standing toe touch.

instructions_en: Stand and cross one leg behind the other, keeping the back leg straight and the front knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward the foot of the back leg.
Hold the stretch in the back of that thigh, then switch leg positions.

decisions.name: Plank-to-Elbow Extension
decisions.reason: High plank to forearm plank and back (up-down plank); not in the library.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and body straight.
Lower onto one forearm, then the other, to reach a forearm plank.
Push back up one hand at a time to the high plank, alternating the lead arm and keeping your hips still.

decisions.name: Cossack squat
decisions.reason: Wide-stance squat shifting onto one leg at a time; not a bilateral squat like Bodyweight Squat.

instructions_en: Stand in a very wide stance with your toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and squat deeply on that leg while the other leg stays straight, toes up.
Push back up through the bent leg to the center, then repeat to the other side.

decisions.name: Wall-sit
decisions.reason: Same isometric wall sit as the earlier Wall Squat candidate.

decisions.name: Dragon-flag
decisions.reason: Advanced bench-anchored core lever; not in the library.

instructions_en: Lie on a bench and grip it firmly behind your head.
Raise your hips and legs until your body is nearly vertical, resting only on your upper back.
Keeping your body straight from shoulders to feet, lower it slowly until just above the bench, then raise it again.

decisions.name: Plank with Alternating Leg Lift
decisions.reason: Plank with alternating leg lifts; not in the library.

instructions_en: Hold a forearm or high plank with your body straight and core braced.
Lift one straight leg a few inches, squeezing the glute, without rotating your hips.
Lower it and repeat with the other leg.

decisions.name: Heel Touches
decisions.reason: Same lying side-to-side heel touch.

decisions.name: bicycle crunches
decisions.reason: The library's Air Bike is the bicycle crunch (alternating elbow to knee).

decisions.name: Hack Squats
decisions.reason: Machine hack squat; source equipment mapping wrong.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Crunches
decisions.reason: Weighted crunch holding a dumbbell; library crunches are bodyweight.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without dropping your head.

decisions.name: Biceps Curl Machine
decisions.reason: Same machine biceps curl.

decisions.name: Toe Taps
decisions.reason: Lying tabletop toe taps; differs from the crunch-based Toe Touchers and the Dead Bug.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees over your hips and your lower back pressed into the floor.
Keeping the knee angle fixed, lower one foot to tap the floor.
Return it to the tabletop position and alternate legs without arching your back.

decisions.name: Standing Side Crunches
decisions.reason: Standing side bend toward the hip; same as the earlier Side Crunch candidate, which is also done standing.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Rotations
decisions.reason: Dumbbell rotator-cuff rotation; covered by the library's dumbbell External Rotation.

decisions.name: Plate Pinch Hold
decisions.reason: Same plate pinch grip hold.

decisions.name: Reverse Wood Chops
decisions.reason: Performed with a resistance band (excluded equipment); the cable version is already in the library as Standing Cable Lift.

decisions.name: Lat Pull DB
decisions.reason: Unclear, non-standard dumbbell movement; the name and cues do not identify a recognisable exercise.

decisions.name: Scapula Pulls
decisions.reason: Same scapular pull-up on a bar.

decisions.name: Pin Bench Press BB
decisions.reason: Bench press paused on pins; same as Pin Presses.

decisions.name: Pin Squat
decisions.reason: Squat with a dead stop on safety pins at a set depth; a named variant of the back squat.

instructions_en: Set the safety pins of a power rack at your target depth and take the bar on your upper back.
Squat down until the bar rests on the pins, pausing briefly while staying tight.
Drive up explosively from the pins to standing.

decisions.name: Pin OHP
decisions.reason: Overhead press from pins at chin height; Pin Presses is a bench movement.

instructions_en: Set the safety pins in a rack at about chin height and rest the bar on them.
Stand under the bar, grip it just outside shoulder width, and brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar from a dead stop to lockout overhead, then lower it back onto the pins.

decisions.name: Push OHP
decisions.reason: Leg drive into an overhead press is the push press.

decisions.name: Incline OHP DB
decisions.reason: Dumbbell press on a 45-degree incline bench; same as Incline Dumbbell Press.

decisions.name: Kreis Press DB
decisions.reason: Obscure, non-standard combination press with an unrecognised name.

decisions.name: Shoulder Raise Side and Front DB
decisions.reason: Same alternating lateral and front raise.

decisions.name: Jerk OL
decisions.reason: A jerk caught in a lunge is the split jerk.

decisions.name: Clean and Jerk OL
decisions.reason: Same clean and jerk; source suffix only.

decisions.name: Snatch OL
decisions.reason: Same snatch; source suffix only.

decisions.name: Seated W Curl
decisions.reason: Seated incline-bench dumbbell curl; same as Incline Dumbbell Curl.

decisions.name: ClimbMill
decisions.reason: ClimbMill is a revolving-stair climber, the same machine as Step Mill.

decisions.name: Cobra Stretch
decisions.reason: Static prone back-extension stretch; not in the library.

instructions_en: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor.
Press through your palms to lift your chest, keeping your hips down and elbows slightly bent.
Hold with your shoulders relaxed away from your ears, then lower slowly.

decisions.name: Torso rotation stretch
decisions.reason: Standing torso twist hold; same as Middle Back Stretch.

decisions.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
decisions.reason: Same lying single knee-to-chest stretch.

decisions.name: Towel Superman
decisions.reason: Non-standard home variation of the Superman using a towel prop.

decisions.name: Cable Press Around
decisions.reason: Single-arm cable press across the body; not in the library.

instructions_en: Set a cable at chest height, hold the handle at your chest, and turn your torso about 45 degrees away from the stack.
Press the handle forward and across your body until your hand passes your midline, arm straight.
Return slowly to your chest with control.

decisions.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise
decisions.reason: One arm pulling from a single low pulley across the body; the library Cable Y-Raise is the two-arm crossed-cable version.

instructions_en: Set a pulley low and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with your far hand in front of the opposite hip.
Sweep the arm up and across your body into a Y, thumb up, until the hand passes shoulder height.
Lower slowly along the same path without shrugging, then switch sides.

decisions.name: No Leg Drive Dumbbell Chest Press
decisions.reason: Flat dumbbell bench press with the feet lifted; a setup cue, not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: punches
decisions.reason: Shadow-boxing punches; a boxing drill, not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Underhand Dead Row
decisions.reason: Underhand grip; the library's two-dumbbell bent-over rows use overhand or neutral grips.

instructions_en: Hold two dumbbells with an underhand grip and hinge at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Row the dumbbells to your lower ribs, driving the elbows back close to your sides.
Lower them under control until your arms are straight, keeping the hinge position.

decisions.name: Pause Hack Squats
decisions.reason: Named tempo variant with a 1-2 second pause at the bottom, like Pause Squat versus Barbell Back Squat.

instructions_en: Set your back against the pad with shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel, then hold the bottom still for one to two seconds.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up without bouncing.

decisions.name: Calf Raise using Hack Squat Machine
decisions.reason: Calf raise on the hack squat machine; same as candidate wger-148 (Calf Raises on Hackenschmitt Machine).

decisions.name: Incline Close Grip Barbell Bench Press
decisions.reason: Incline bench angle; the library Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press is flat.

instructions_en: Lie on a bench set to about 30 degrees and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with the elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders until your elbows lock.

decisions.name: Floor Skull Crusher
decisions.reason: Lying on the floor with a dead stop each rep; differs from the bench skull crusher.

instructions_en: Lie on the floor with knees bent and hold an EZ-bar over your chest with straight arms.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar behind your head until the plates touch the floor.
Pause briefly, then extend the elbows to press the bar back over your chest.

decisions.name: Bent over Cable Flye
decisions.reason: Forward-leaning cable crossover from high pulleys is the standard cable chest fly.

decisions.name: 1-Arm Half-Kneeling Lat Pulldown
decisions.reason: Kneeling single-arm pull down from a high pulley; same as the library's Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row.

decisions.name: Kroc Row
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library Kroc Row.

decisions.name: Reverse Cable Flye
decisions.reason: Crossed high-pulley reverse fly is the library Cable Rear Delt Fly.

decisions.name: W-Raise
decisions.reason: Source describes a gimmicky leg-drawing reverse crunch, not the shoulder W-raise; not a standard exercise.

decisions.name: Black Widow Knee Slides
decisions.reason: Obscure branded core move; essentially a cross-body plank knee drive covered by Mountain Climbers and Spider Crawl.

decisions.name: Butterfly Sit Up
decisions.reason: Butterfly sit-up (soles together, knees out) is the library's Frog Sit-Ups.

decisions.name: Seated Corkscrew
decisions.reason: Obscure seated knee-tuck twist with a gimmick name; not a standard gym exercise.

decisions.name: Levitation Crunch
decisions.reason: A crunch with a pause at the top; no material difference from Crunches.

decisions.name: Sit Up Elbow Thrust
decisions.reason: Sit-up driving the elbow across to the opposite knee; same as the library Elbow to Knee.

decisions.name: Lying Triceps Extensions
decisions.reason: Lying barbell triceps extension is the library Lying Triceps Press.

decisions.name: Drag Pushdown
decisions.reason: Rope pushdown with the elbows kept slightly back; a technique cue on the Triceps Rope Pushdown.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Cheat Curl
decisions.reason: A dumbbell curl done with momentum; same movement as the Dumbbell Biceps Curl.

decisions.name: Bizeps Curls Trifecta
decisions.reason: A set combining three different curls, not a single exercise.

decisions.name: Omni Cable Cross-over
decisions.reason: Vague crossover with one cable high and one low; no established exercise behind the name.

decisions.name: Rocking Triceps Pushdown
decisions.reason: Gimmicky whole-body rocking version of the rope pushdown.

decisions.name: Alternating High Cable Row
decisions.reason: Standing staggered stance from a head-height pulley; the library's single-arm high pulley row is kneeling.

instructions_en: Set a pulley at head height, hold the handle in one hand and step back into a staggered stance, arm extended.
Row the elbow down and back toward your hip, letting the torso turn slightly toward the working side.
Return slowly until the arm is straight and the lat is stretched, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Hyper Y W Combo
decisions.reason: Combination of two raises on a hyperextension bench or stability ball; not a single exercise.

decisions.name: Plank Jacks
decisions.reason: Adds jumping-jack leg movement for conditioning; the Plank is a static hold.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and feet together.
Jump both feet out wide and back together in a steady rhythm, like a jumping jack.
Keep your hips level with your shoulders and your core braced throughout.

decisions.name: Lying Triceps Kickback
decisions.reason: Chest-supported on an incline bench with both arms; the library kickback is bent over without support.

instructions_en: Set a bench to a steep incline and lie face down on it, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Pull your elbows up beside your torso so the upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Extend the elbows until your arms are straight, then bend them slowly while the upper arms stay still.

decisions.name: Remada unilateral no cabo
decisions.reason: Portuguese for single-arm cable row; same as the library Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows.

decisions.name: High Row
decisions.reason: Source describes a kneeling single-arm high cable pull; same as the library Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row.

decisions.name: Bayesian Curl
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library Bayesian Cable Curl.

decisions.name: DB Upper Chest Variation
decisions.reason: Vague curl-like dumbbell movement with no recognisable name.

decisions.name: DB Underhand bench press
decisions.reason: Underhand grip with tucked elbows; the grip makes it different from the Dumbbell Bench Press.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with an underhand grip, palms facing your head.
Lower them to your lower chest, keeping the elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press back up until your arms are straight, wrists stacked over the elbows.

decisions.name: Elbows Tucked DB Bench Press
decisions.reason: Neutral-grip dumbbell press with elbows tucked is the library Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip.

decisions.name: DB UCV
decisions.reason: Unclear abbreviation for a vague curl-like dumbbell movement.

decisions.name: Alternative DB Gorilla rows
decisions.reason: Wide-stance, deep-hinge alternating row from the floor; differs from the standard bent-over dumbbell rows.

instructions_en: Stand wide with two dumbbells on the floor between your feet, hinge deeply with knees bent and back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your hip while the other stays planted on the floor for support.
Lower it to the floor and row the other side, alternating while your hips stay still.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Frog Press
decisions.reason: Bridge with the soles together and knees out; differs from the glute bridge and hip thrust.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together, knees falling out, and a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Drive through the outer edges of your feet to lift your hips, squeezing your glutes hard at the top.
Lower slowly until your hips almost touch the floor.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Bradford press
decisions.reason: Awkward dumbbell adaptation of the Bradford press that is rarely programmed; the barbell versions are already in the library.

decisions.name: High-Incline Smith Machine Press
decisions.reason: Source sets the bench at 45-60 degrees, a normal incline; same as Smith Machine Incline Bench Press.

decisions.name: Cable Tricep Kickback
decisions.reason: Cable version; the library only has the dumbbell kickback.

instructions_en: Set a pulley low, hold the handle in one hand and hinge forward with the upper arm pinned beside your torso.
Straighten the elbow to move the handle back until the arm is fully extended.
Return slowly to about 90 degrees of elbow bend without letting the upper arm drop.

decisions.name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown
decisions.reason: Shoulder-width parallel handles; the library V-Bar Pulldown uses a close neutral grip.

instructions_en: Attach a bar with parallel handles about shoulder-width apart, sit down and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull the handles to your upper chest, driving your elbows down toward your sides.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight and the lats stretch.

decisions.name: Kong Curl
decisions.reason: Obscure alternating pronated cable curl with a gimmick name; no established exercise.

decisions.name: Drop Curl
decisions.reason: Vague alternating partial dumbbell curl; not an established exercise.

decisions.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library Overhead Cable Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Lateral Walk
decisions.reason: Squat-position side steps; a band or warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Leg Press Toe Press
decisions.reason: Calf press on the leg press is already in the library.

decisions.name: Handstand
decisions.reason: Static balance hold with no pressing; differs from Handstand Push-Ups.

instructions_en: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor and kick up into a vertical handstand.
Lock your elbows, push the floor away and squeeze your core and glutes to keep a straight line.
Balance with small finger and wrist adjustments, then step down with control.

decisions.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: EZ-bar overhead triceps extension; the library entry covers barbell or EZ-bar.

decisions.name: Sled Push
decisions.reason: Sled push; sleds are excluded.

decisions.name: Battle Ropes
decisions.reason: Battle ropes are excluded.

decisions.name: Ball Slams
decisions.reason: Needs a medicine or slam ball.

decisions.name: Ski Machine
decisions.reason: Ski ergometer cardio machine; not yet in the library.

instructions_en: Stand facing the machine with feet hip-width apart and reach up to grip both handles.
Pull the handles down past your thighs while hinging at the hips and bending the knees slightly.
Stand tall as your arms return overhead, then repeat in a smooth rhythm.

decisions.name: Glute Drive
decisions.reason: Glute Drive is a hip thrust machine; same as candidate Machine Hip Thrust.

decisions.name: Lying Dumbbell Curls
decisions.reason: Lying face up on a bench and curling from a hang; same as the library Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl.

decisions.name: Cable Curls
decisions.reason: Plain cable curl; same as the library Standing Biceps Cable Curl.

decisions.name: lying bicep curl
decisions.reason: Lying dumbbell curl on a bench; same as the library Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl.

decisions.name: Delt Stretch
decisions.reason: Too vague: no position or direction for the deltoid stretch.

decisions.name: Pull-up Isometric Hold
decisions.reason: Static hold in the pull-up position; differs from dynamic pull-ups and from dead hangs.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Pull yourself to the chosen height, usually chin over the bar, and stop.
Hold that position with shoulders pulled down and core tight, then lower slowly.

decisions.name: Wide Pull Up
decisions.reason: Wide front grip; differs from the standard pull-up and from the library's behind-the-neck wide-grip version.

instructions_en: Grip the bar overhand with hands well outside shoulder width and hang with straight arms.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and out until your chin clears it.
Lower yourself under control to a full hang.

decisions.name: Archer Pull Up
decisions.reason: Shifts the load onto one arm as a one-arm pull-up progression; differs from standard pull-ups.

instructions_en: Grip the bar overhand much wider than shoulder width and hang with straight arms.
Pull toward one hand, bending that arm while the other arm straightens along the bar.
Lower to a full hang and repeat toward the other side.

decisions.name: Larsen Press
decisions.reason: Named bench press variant with legs straight and no leg drive.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench and straighten your legs out in front, heels resting lightly on the floor or a bench.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid chest without any leg drive.
Press back to lockout, keeping your hips and shoulders on the bench.

decisions.name: Stair Master
decisions.reason: Same machine as the library Stairmaster.

decisions.name: Clap Push-UP
decisions.reason: Clap push-up is a plyometric push-up; same as the library Plyo Push-up.

decisions.name: Devil's Press
decisions.reason: Burpee plus double dumbbell snatch; not in the library.

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor, hands on the dumbbells.
Jump your feet in, hinge over the dumbbells and swing them back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to bring both dumbbells overhead in one motion, lock out, then lower them under control.

decisions.name: Ab wheel
decisions.reason: Ab wheel rollout is the library Ab Roller.

decisions.name: Schwimmen
decisions.reason: German for swimming; same activity as candidate wger-961 (Swimming).

decisions.name: Snap Down
decisions.reason: Landing and plyometric drill.

decisions.name: Bretzel stretch
decisions.reason: Combined hip flexor, quad and upper-back rotation stretch; not in the library.

instructions_en: Lie on your side and bend your top knee forward to hip height, holding it to the floor with your bottom hand.
Bend your bottom leg behind you and hold that foot with your top hand.
Rotate your upper back and top shoulder toward the floor behind you and breathe slowly as you hold.

decisions.name: Hip hinge
decisions.reason: A movement-pattern drill rather than an exercise; loaded hinges are already covered (Good Morning, Romanian Deadlift).

decisions.name: Bronco
decisions.reason: Rugby shuttle-run fitness test, not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Perpendicular Unilateral Landmine Row
decisions.reason: Single-arm row standing perpendicular to a landmine bar is the library Meadows Row.

decisions.name: Trap press
decisions.reason: Misnamed: describes a supine scapular protraction (serratus punch), a niche rehab drill with no matching muscle key.

decisions.name: Side-laying interior rotation
decisions.reason: Dumbbell side-lying version; the library only has the cable internal rotation.

instructions_en: Lie on your side on a bench with the bottom elbow bent to 90 degrees and a light dumbbell in that hand.
Keeping the upper arm still, rotate the forearm up toward your stomach.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back down past the bench edge, as far as is comfortable.

decisions.name: Supine press
decisions.reason: Close-grip barbell press lying on a bench; same as the library Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press.

decisions.name: March or jog in place
decisions.reason: Marching or jogging in place is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
decisions.reason: Both feet on the floor; the library Smith Single-Leg Split Squat has the rear foot on a bench.

instructions_en: Set the bar across your upper back in a Smith machine and step into a long split stance, both feet on the floor.
Lower straight down until the back knee nears the floor and the front thigh is about parallel.
Push through the front foot to rise, finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
decisions.reason: Source version uses a kettlebell and a slider disc; a minor variant of the lateral lunge.

decisions.name: Arm Raises (T/Y/I)
decisions.reason: Combination of three different raises in one entry, not a single exercise.

decisions.name: Typewriter Pull-ups
decisions.reason: Traverses side to side at the top; differs from standard pull-ups and the diagonal Side To Side Chins.

instructions_en: Grip the bar overhand, wider than shoulder width, and pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Stay high and slide your body toward one hand while the other arm straightens, then move across to the other side.
Return to the center and lower yourself under control to a full hang.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: Bodyweight curl under a fixed bar; different equipment from the cable curl.

instructions_en: Grip a waist-high fixed bar underhand, walk your feet forward and lean back with straight arms and a rigid body.
Curl your body up by bending only at the elbows until your forehead nears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
decisions.reason: Dumbbell-loaded; the library only has the barbell hip thrust.

instructions_en: Sit with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, feet flat and a dumbbell held across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs and torso are level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips under control.

decisions.name: Treadmill Cardio
decisions.reason: Generic treadmill cardio; the library already has treadmill running, jogging and walking.

decisions.name: Patada de burro con mancuerna
decisions.reason: Spanish for dumbbell donkey kick; a quadruped glute kickback with added load, same as the library Glute Kickback.

decisions.name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Both legs at once; the library Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise is single-leg.

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised plate or step and dumbbells resting on your knees.
Lower your heels slowly for a full stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as possible, pause, then lower again.

decisions.name: Unilateral Cable row
decisions.reason: Single-arm seated cable row; same as the library Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows.

decisions.name: Modified pulldown
decisions.reason: Vague 'modified' close-grip pulldown with an unclear bench setup.

decisions.name: Barbell Clean and press
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library Clean and Press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Bent Over Face Pull
decisions.reason: Bent-over dumbbell pull to the face with elbows high; same as candidate wger-1227 (Dumbbell Rear Delt Row).

decisions.name: Dumbbell Front Squat
decisions.reason: Dumbbells racked on the front of the shoulders; the library Dumbbell Squat holds them at the sides.

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand resting on the front of your shoulders, elbows high, feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down between your hips with an upright torso until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up, keeping the elbows high.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
decisions.reason: Two-leg version; the closest library match is single-leg, and the library keeps the RDL separate from the stiff-legged deadlift.

instructions_en: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs, back flat, until your hamstrings stretch strongly.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes at the top.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Side Squat
decisions.reason: Steps to the side and bends one knee; a lateral lunge, not a bilateral squat.

instructions_en: Stand with feet together holding a dumbbell at your chest or in one hand.
Take a wide step to the side and sit your hips back over that foot, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start, then repeat on the other side.

decisions.name: Machine lateral wise
decisions.reason: Machine lateral raise is already in the library.

decisions.name: Preacher Curl - Internally Rotated
decisions.reason: Single-arm dumbbell preacher curl with the body turned slightly; no material difference.

decisions.name: Preacher Curl - Externally Rotated
decisions.reason: Single-arm dumbbell preacher curl with the body turned slightly; no material difference.

decisions.name: Lat Pulldown - Cross Body Single Arm
decisions.reason: Seated diagonally so the pull crosses the body for a longer lat stretch; differs in body position from One Arm Lat Pulldown.

instructions_en: Sit at a pulldown station turned diagonally, one thigh under the pad, and grab a single handle with the opposite arm.
Pull the handle down and across toward your hip, driving the elbow to your side.
Let the arm rise slowly across your body until the lat is fully stretched, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Cable Triceps Press
decisions.reason: Unclear single-arm cable triceps press with no established name; pushdown and extension variants already cover it.

decisions.name: Cable Tri Extension - Internal Rotation
decisions.reason: Elbow extension across the body from a side pulley; differs from pushdowns and overhead extensions.

instructions_en: Set a pulley at shoulder height, stand side-on and hold the handle near the cable-side shoulder with your far hand.
Keep the elbow up and still, then straighten the arm across your body away from the stack.
Bend the elbow slowly to bring the handle back to the shoulder, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Cable Tri Extension - External Rotation
decisions.reason: Same cross-body single-arm cable triceps extension as wger-1662; only the body turn differs.

decisions.name: Curl  - With Shoulder Elevated
