decisions.reason: Vague curl with the elbow raised to shoulder level; no clear setup or established name.

decisions.name: Leg Swings (Front–Back)
decisions.reason: Dynamic leg swings are a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Seated Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Described as the seated abductor machine; same as Thigh Abductor.

instructions_en: Stand with your head, upper back and hips against a wall, feet a little in front of you.
Raise your arms into a goalpost shape with elbows and wrists touching the wall.
Slide your arms overhead and back down slowly, keeping contact with the wall and your ribs down.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Thruster
decisions.reason: Barbell Thruster (wger-650) is a separate candidate with different equipment.

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your shoulders with palms facing in.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel, keeping your chest up.
Drive up and use the momentum to press the dumbbells overhead, then lower them back to your shoulders.

row.name_en: Dumbbell Single-Arm Glute Bridge Floor Press
instructions_en: Lie on your back, knees bent, and lift your hips into a glute bridge with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Lower the dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor, keeping your hips high.
Press it back up without letting your torso rotate; finish the set, then switch arms.
Get on hands and knees with a dumbbell beside one hip, then lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Reach under your body with the opposite hand and drag the dumbbell across to the other side.
Replace your hand and repeat with the other arm, keeping your hips level and still.

decisions.name: Kickstand RDL
decisions.reason: Staggered kickstand stance that loads mostly one leg; a different stance from the standard Romanian Deadlift.

instructions_en: Hold a barbell at your hips and set one foot slightly back with only its toes down for balance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, loading the front leg, until you feel a stretch in its hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall; finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Cable Fly Middle Chest
decisions.reason: Mid-height cable fly is the standard Cable Chest Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Fly Upper Chest
decisions.reason: Upper-chest cable fly sweeps up from low pulleys; same as Low-to-High Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Fly Lower Chest
decisions.reason: Lower-chest cable fly sweeps down from high pulleys; same as High-to-Low Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Incline Smith Press
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Smith Machine Incline Bench Press.

decisions.name: Incline Static Hold
decisions.reason: An isometric hold at mid-range of the incline dumbbell press; a set technique, not a distinct exercise.

decisions.name: Flat Machine Press
decisions.reason: Flat seated machine chest press; same as Machine Bench Press.

decisions.name: Pull-Ups (Wide Grip)
decisions.reason: Wide-grip pull-up; same as candidate Wide Pull Up (no library row for the front wide-grip pull-up).

decisions.name: Pull-Ups (Neutral Grip)
decisions.reason: Shoulder-width parallel handles; V-Bar Pullup is a close neutral grip and the narrow parallel-grip chin-up candidates are close too.

instructions_en: Hang from parallel handles set about shoulder-width apart, palms facing each other, arms straight.
Pull your chest up toward the handles by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself under control to a full hang.

decisions.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
decisions.reason: The library Lat Pulldown is the wide-grip front pulldown.

decisions.name: Barbell Row (Overhand)
decisions.reason: Overhand barbell row is the standard Barbell Bent-Over Row.

decisions.name: Barbell Row (Underhand)
decisions.reason: Underhand barbell row; same as Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows.

decisions.name: One-Arm Heavy Row
decisions.reason: A one-arm dumbbell row; 'heavy' only describes the load.

decisions.name: Patadas traseras
decisions.reason: Spanish for the dumbbell triceps kickback; same as Tricep Dumbbell Kickback.

decisions.name: Bulgarian Squat with Dumbbells
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Bulgarian Split Squat with dumbbells.

instructions_en: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees.
With the top hand, gently press the bottom forearm down toward the floor.
Hold where you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Horizontal Shoulder Flexion Stretch
decisions.reason: A wall or doorway chest stretch with a straight arm; same stretch as Doorway Pectoral Stretch.

instructions_en: Stand in a doorway and place your forearm vertically against the frame, elbow at about shoulder height.
Step forward through the doorway until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Shoulder Dumbbell Pendular Exercise
decisions.reason: Codman pendulum swing is a passive shoulder rehab drill, not a training exercise.

decisions.name: Shoulder External Rotation with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Side-lying dumbbell external rotation; same as External Rotation.

decisions.name: Neck extension
decisions.reason: Mislabeled record: named Neck Extension with SZ-bar equipment but describes a single-arm high-pulley triceps extension.

decisions.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
decisions.reason: Machine version; the library has only bodyweight and cable kickbacks.

instructions_en: Set up on the kickback machine with your torso braced and one foot against the platform or pad.
Drive the leg back through the heel until your hip is fully extended.
Return slowly without arching your lower back; finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Seated Row (Machine)
decisions.reason: Seated row machine with a chest pad; same as Machine Chest-Supported Row.

decisions.name: Side Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
decisions.reason: One arm, standing side-on, arm sweeping down beside the body; Straight-Arm Pulldown is a two-arm bar pull in front.

instructions_en: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle in the near hand, arm straight and raised out to the side.
Keeping the elbow almost locked, sweep the arm down in an arc to your hip.
Return slowly to the stretch without leaning or twisting your torso.

decisions.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation (Cable)
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Cable Internal Rotation.

decisions.name: Shoulder External Rotation (Cable)
decisions.reason: Same exercise as External Rotation with Cable.

decisions.name: Side Lateral Raise (Cable)
decisions.reason: Standard standing cable lateral raise; same as Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise.

decisions.name: Isometric Squat to Failure
decisions.reason: A set technique (static squat held to failure); the isometric squat is covered by the Wall-sit candidate.

decisions.name: Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your straight legs until your feet point toward the ceiling.
Lower your legs to one side in a controlled arc, keeping them together.
Sweep them back through the middle to the other side without swinging your body.

decisions.name: Machine Side Lateral Raises
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Machine Lateral Raise.

decisions.name: Cable Front Raise with a small bar
decisions.reason: Cable front raise with a short bar; same as candidate Straight Bar Cable Front Raise.

decisions.name: Floor dumbbell bench press
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Dumbbell Floor Press.

decisions.name: Machine Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Seated abduction machine; same as Thigh Abductor.

decisions.name: Seated Triceps Press
decisions.reason: Seated triceps press machine (Spanish name: machine dips); same as Dip Machine.

decisions.name: Side lateral raise - Front (Cable)
decisions.reason: Cable running in front of the body is the standard single-arm cable lateral raise.

decisions.name: Side lateral raise - Back (Cable)
decisions.reason: Cable running behind the body; same as Behind the Back Cable Lateral Raise in this batch.

decisions.name: Legend Incline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Brand-name plate-loaded incline press; same as Leverage Incline Chest Press.

decisions.name: Deficit Push ups
decisions.reason: Push-up with the hands raised so the chest sinks below them: the same exercise as Push-Ups | Parallettes (Deficit Push-Up).

decisions.name: unilateral cross body cable pull down
decisions.reason: Vague, non-standard straight-arm cable sweep with no clear target or recognisable name.

decisions.name: Trap Bar Squat
decisions.reason: A trap bar squat is the trap bar deadlift with a knee-dominant setup; same movement and bar.

decisions.name: ankle dorsiflexion rocks
decisions.reason: Ankle dorsiflexion rocks are a dynamic mobility warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Lat Pull Down
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Behind the Back Cable Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: The cable runs behind the body, a commonly distinguished variant of the single-arm cable lateral raise.

instructions_en: Stand side-on to a low pulley and take the handle in the far hand, with the cable running behind your back.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbow.
Lower it slowly; finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Parallel Bar Hold
decisions.reason: Static top position of the dip. Candidate lift-supportHold:bodyweight Support Hold is the same exercise.

instructions_en: Grip the parallel bars and press down to lift yourself, arms straight and shoulders pushed away from your ears.
Keep your body upright with legs together or bent behind you.
Hold the position, then step down under control.

decisions.name: Sphinx
decisions.reason: Forearm-supported, gentler than the straight-arm Cobra Stretch candidate.

instructions_en: Lie face down with your legs straight and the tops of your feet on the floor.
Prop yourself up on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders, and lift your chest.
Hold, keeping your hips down and your lower back relaxed.

decisions.name: Clamshell
decisions.reason: Candidate lift-sideLyingClam:bodyweight Side Lying Clam is the same exercise.

instructions_en: Lie on your side propped on your forearm, hips stacked and knees bent.
Keeping your feet together, lift the top knee as high as you can without rolling your hips back.
Lower it slowly; finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Dumbell Tate Press
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Tate Press.

decisions.name: Chest-Supported Rear Delt Raise
decisions.reason: Prone rear delt raise on an incline bench; same as Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and your hands on your thighs above the knees.
Push your hands into your legs while your abs pull the knees toward your hands, so nothing moves.
Hold the effort for several seconds while breathing, then relax.

decisions.name: Abdominal Draw-In
decisions.reason: Same navel-to-spine draw-in as Stomach Vacuum; lying instead of standing is a minor change.

decisions.name: Landmine Squat to Press
decisions.reason: Adds a full squat before each press; Landmine Press is the press alone and Linear Jammer uses a short dip.

instructions_en: Stand facing a landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel, keeping your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar forward and up to straight arms, then lower it to your chest.

decisions.name: Barbell Step Back Lunge
decisions.reason: Stepping back from the floor; the library has the forward Barbell Lunge and the deficit Elevated Back Lunge. Candidates lift-reverseLunge:barbell, ek-0128 and edb-0077 are the same exercise.

instructions_en: Stand with a barbell across your upper back and feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then alternate legs.

decisions.name: Hammerstrength Decline Chest Press
decisions.reason: Brand-name plate-loaded decline press; same as Leverage Decline Chest Press.

instructions_en: Hinge forward with soft knees and one hand on your knee, the working arm hanging with thumb up.
Set the shoulder blade down and back, then raise the straight arm up and out in line with your ear.
Lower slowly without shrugging; finish the set, then switch arms.

decisions.name: External Rotation Stretch
decisions.reason: Mislabeled record: named a stretch but describes a knee-supported external rotation with mixed barbell or dumbbell equipment.

decisions.name: Solo Hip Flexor Stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only kneeling hip flexor stretch; same as Kneeling Hip Flexor.

decisions.name: Bent-Leg Hamstring Stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only record; the bent-leg variant cannot be identified and the library already has several hamstring stretches.

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with legs in front and hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing back.
Keep your elbows straight and slide your hips forward, away from your hands.
Hold when you feel a stretch in the front of your shoulders and chest.

decisions.name: Butterfly Stretch
decisions.reason: A seated groin stretch, not the Butterfly chest machine. Candidate edb-1494 Butterfly Yoga Pose is the same stretch.

instructions_en: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides.
Hold your feet and draw them toward your groin.
Hold, letting your knees sink toward the floor without bouncing.

decisions.name: Frog Stretch
decisions.reason: Candidate edb-2571 Rocking Frog Stretch is the same stretch.

instructions_en: Start on hands and knees, then slide your knees wide apart with your feet in line with your knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Gently shift your hips back toward your heels until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs, then hold.

decisions.name: Seated Pancake Good Morning
decisions.reason: Seated wide-leg forward hinge; same as The Straddle, hands behind the head is a minor change.

decisions.name: Horse Stance (Side Splits)
decisions.reason: Confused record: the name mixes a horse-stance hold and side splits, and the description is a paused bodyweight wide squat.

instructions_en: Sit with your legs straight and spread wide, hands on the floor or parallettes between your legs.
Press down through straight arms to lift your hips and legs off the floor.
Hold with legs straight and toes pointed, then lower under control.

decisions.name: L-sit
decisions.reason: Legs held together in front; Straddle L-Sit spreads them wide. Candidate edb-3419 L-Sit On Floor is the same exercise.

instructions_en: Sit with your legs straight and together, hands on the floor or parallettes beside your hips.
Press down through straight arms to lift your hips and legs off the floor.
Hold with your legs level and knees locked, then lower under control.

decisions.name: L-Sit (Foot Supported)
decisions.reason: Feet-supported regression of the L-Sit; a near-identical variant that only adds noise.

decisions.name: Side stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only record with a vague name; cannot tell which side stretch is meant.

decisions.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only generic hip flexor stretch; same as Kneeling Hip Flexor.

decisions.name: Lunge with Twist Stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only lunge-and-twist warm-up drill; World's Greatest Stretch already covers this pattern.

decisions.name: Lying Figure Four Stretch
decisions.reason: Lying figure-four glute stretch; same as Ankle On The Knee.

decisions.name: Lying Knee to Chest Stretch
decisions.reason: Same stretch as One Knee To Chest.

instructions_en: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind your wrist with the shin angled across your body.
Slide the other leg straight back and lower your hips toward the floor.
Hold, upright or folded over the front leg, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Runners Lunge Stretch
decisions.reason: Same lunge stretch as Runner's Stretch.

decisions.name: Supported Calf Stretch
decisions.reason: Video-only supported calf stretch; same as Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall.

decisions.name: Incline DB Y-Raise
decisions.reason: Chest-supported dumbbell version; the library Y-raise is the standing cable one.

instructions_en: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, holding light dumbbells with palms facing in.
Raise your straight arms up and out into a Y until they line up with your ears.
Lower slowly without shrugging.

decisions.name: High-Cable Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Single-arm cable lateral raise with the pulley set higher; a minor setup change.

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your front leg bent 90 degrees in front and your back leg bent 90 degrees to the side.
Keep both shins and knees on the floor and your hips square.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin and hold, then switch sides.
Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells hanging and thumbs up.
Raise your arms into a Y, then a T, then pull your elbows back into a W.
Finish with an L by rotating the forearms up from bent elbows, then lower and repeat the sequence.

decisions.name: Supine Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Low-load supine leg-slide rehab drill; hip abduction is covered by the side-lying, cable and machine options.

decisions.name: Tricep Rope Pushdowns
decisions.reason: Same exercise as Triceps Rope Pushdown.

decisions.name: Pec Deck
decisions.reason: The pec deck is the Butterfly machine.

decisions.name: Pullback
decisions.reason: Vague description of a bent-over cable pull with back extension; cannot be identified.

decisions.name: Hip Bridge
decisions.reason: A generic hip (glute) bridge; same as Butt Lift (Bridge).

decisions.name: Unilateral Lunges
decisions.reason: Generic bodyweight lunge; same as candidate Bodyweight lunge HD (also lift-lunge:bodyweight).

decisions.name: Butterfly Superman
decisions.reason: Prone chest lift; same as Lower Back Curl, hands behind the head is a minor change.

decisions.name: Leg Wheel
decisions.reason: Non-standard name for a small supine knee-circle drill; not a recognisable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Kneeling Superman
decisions.reason: Opposite arm and leg reach from all fours; same as Bird Dog.

decisions.name: Cat Plank
decisions.reason: Source name Cat Plank; a hover on hands and toes with knees just off the floor, not the forearm Plank.

instructions_en: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Lift your knees an inch off the floor and push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades.
Hold with your back flat and hips level, breathing steadily.

decisions.name: Core Rotation
decisions.reason: Seated twist with feet raised, touching the floor each side; same as Russian Twist.

decisions.name: Unilateral Hip Thrust
decisions.reason: Upper back on a bench, unlike the floor Single Leg Glute Bridge. Candidate lift-singleLegHipThrust:bodyweight is the same exercise.

instructions_en: Sit with your upper back against a bench, one foot flat on the floor and the other leg raised.
Drive through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control; finish the set, then switch legs.
Place your hands on the floor or parallettes beside your hips, fingers turned slightly out.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands and lift your feet, pulling your knees tight to your chest.
Hold with arms straight and upper back rounded, then lower your feet.

decisions.name: Extreme Pec Stretch
decisions.reason: Vague loaded-stretch concept for the chest with no defined setup or equipment.

decisions.name: Extreme Shoulder Stretch
decisions.reason: Vague loaded-stretch concept for the shoulders with no defined setup or equipment.

decisions.name: Extreme Lat Stretch
decisions.reason: Vague loaded-stretch concept for the lats with no defined setup or equipment.

decisions.name: Seated Cable chest fly
decisions.reason: Seated on an upright bench; the library Cable Chest Fly is standing and Flat Bench Cable Flyes is lying.

instructions_en: Set two pulleys at chest height and sit on an upright bench between them, a handle in each hand.
With elbows slightly bent, bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

decisions.name: 3008 Abdominal Crunch
decisions.reason: Brand-numbered (gym80 3008) seated ab crunch machine; same as Ab Crunch Machine.

decisions.name: Barbell Silverback Shrug
decisions.reason: Hinged-forward shrug that retracts the shoulder blades; Barbell Shrug is an upright elevation shrug.

instructions_en: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders and hinge forward about 45 degrees with soft knees.
Keeping your arms straight and back flat, pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Pause briefly, then let the shoulder blades spread apart under control without rounding your upper back.

decisions.name: Inverted Lat Pull Down
decisions.reason: Source describes an underhand shoulder-width lat pulldown; same as Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Curl
decisions.reason: Standard supinating dumbbell curl; same as Dumbbell Biceps Curl.

decisions.name: Abdominal Crunch
decisions.reason: Basic floor crunch; same as Crunches.

instructions_en: Fasten the belt around your hips, stand on the platform and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Release the catch and squat down with an upright torso until your thighs reach at least parallel.
Drive through the mid-foot to stand back up, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
